{
  "categories": [
    {
      "name": "mempool",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Matches Mempool label and modifies CTxMemPool::PrioritiseTransaction in src/txmempool.cpp to prevent FeeFrac integer overflows in cluster mempool.",
      "band": "P2",
      "score": 0.65,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Clamping prioritisation fee deltas resolves signed integer overflow and negative chunk fee calculation in cluster mempool. As noted in the description, extreme deltas trigger a reproducible UBSan runtime error in `feefrac.h:108:13` during linearization and lead to incorrect transaction handling."
    },
    {
      "name": "mining",
      "member": true,
      "evidence": "Modifies prioritisetransaction in src/rpc/mining.cpp and functional tests in test/functional/mining_prioritisetransaction.py, directly impacting transaction inclusion in getblocktemplate.",
      "band": "P3",
      "score": 0.35,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "Prevents prioritized transactions from being incorrectly omitted from getblocktemplate. The PR description shows that overflowing fee deltas across parent and child transactions resulted in negative chunk fees that caused block template construction to drop both transactions."
    },
    {
      "name": "rpc",
      "member": false,
      "evidence": "Lacks the RPC/REST/ZMQ label; the 4-line adjustment in src/rpc/mining.cpp merely handles domain-specific fee delta limits rather than general RPC machinery.",
      "band": "Unranked",
      "score": 0.0,
      "reason_tag": "bug fix",
      "rationale": "The change alters the underlying behavior of prioritisetransaction rather than the RPC layer itself, which category guidelines assign to its domain area."
    }
  ],
